items.title: [Google Play 中评] ★3 The game is so good for turn-based lover
items.summary: The game is so good for turn-based lovers like me, but I have to state weaknesses hopefully someone fixes them. The draw rates, they are so bad , almost every ssr I got for the past 8 days of playing is a pity, not only that, the ssr i get is always not the featured one, which means I have to get the ultimate pity drawfor every single ssr i need. The other thing is the very high ping of 500+ although I have a stable fast internet, they have to work on servers, there is no option to choose server
items.author: Ahmed husein
